meta.title: How effective is drone brood removal on its own?

citations.label: Drone brood removal as mechanical control: a randomised trial
citations.text: Removal reduced mite load by 43% relative to untreated controls over one season, with no effect on colony weight at the end of the season.
dispute_points: Whether mechanical control alone holds mite load below the treatment threshold in high-pressure years.

citations.label: Varroa destructor and honeybee viral loads: a five-year cohort
citations.text: Mechanical control alone did not prevent viral amplification in high-pressure years; DWV titres rose in five of the eight study apiaries.
dispute_points: Whether mechanical control alone holds mite load below the treatment threshold in high-pressure years.
